author: Hosea
overview: God tells Hosea to marry Gomer, who is unfaithful to him. Hosea's broken marriage becomes a picture of Israel's unfaithfulness to God. Yet God's love will not let go: he promises to woo his people back and heal them.
storyPlace: One of the twelve shorter prophetic books known as the Minor Prophets ("minor" because they are short, not less important).
